description: Připojení stavebního objektu k vodovodu is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Digitální a informační agentura. This is one of the data about the building. Coverage: Digitální a informační agentura. The portal shows the English title as "Connection of the building building to the water supply" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Digitální a informační agentura. Its keywords include vodovod, water supply, připojení na vodovod, codelist, connection to the water supply, číselník. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
